notes.title: Shadow Labyrinth – Patch News
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Greetings players, UGSF soldiers, and Swordsmen—thank you for playing Shadow Labyrinth. With the help of our continued testing and your insightful feedback we have begun work to patch-in some game updates. Our focus is to address bugs, difficulty, on-boarding, and quality-of-life to improve your play experience and better deliver on the promise of exploration and combat with PUCK at your side.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our first patch will focus on:[/p][p]·         An issue where the Swordsman may not appear when entering the “Red Crystal Room” in the "Barren Volcano” map area[/p][p]·         An issue where play time may inaccurately include sleep mode[/p][p]·         An issue where players could get stuck in walls and take damage in certain areas of MAZE.[/p][p]·         An issue where the game becomes unplayable if the Swordsman dies while touching a boss at the same time as transforming into GAIA[/p][p]·         Minor UI fixes[/p][p] [/p][p]Additional adjustments to go live later:[/p][p]·         Update the HP Limit Boost PERK to be permanent[/p][p]·         Reduce ORA and resource materials required for merchant items in the “Barren Volcano” map/area[/p][p]·         Reduce ORA required for emergency escape devices and obtaining information[/p][p]·         Add retry option to Maze stage boss battles[/p][p]·         Increase initial number of lives in Maze stages overall[/p][p]·         Address time limits for fairness for clearing Maze stages for all four G-Hosts: Red Bragza: Terrias-Gilba, Blue Bragza: Terrias-Juno, Pink Bragza: Terrias-Boz Rag, and Orange Bragza: Terrias-Valou[/p][p]·         Additional minor adjustments[/p][p] [/p][p]These updates are targeting late August and early September and are intended for all platforms. We will share more details as those times draw closer. In the meantime, we are paying attention to what you have to say, please take our Shadow Labyrinth survey at the following link! (Responses accepted until September 21st.)[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://survey.bandainamcoent.co.jp/jfe/form/SV_0BUMeVvQEyWPbU2"]https://survey.bandainamcoent.co.jp/jfe/form/SV_0BUMeVvQEyWPbU2[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][b]For updates please follow [url="https://x.com/BandaiNamcoUS"]Bandai Namco US on X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/shadowlabyrinthgame/"]Shadow Labyrinth on Instagram[/url], and join the Shadow Labyrinth channel on the [url="http://discord.gg/pacman"]Official PAC-MAN Discord server[/url].[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]END TRANSMISSION.[/p]

notes.title: Метроидвания имени Pac-Man: Обзор Shadow Labyrinth
notes.content: Bandai Namco Entertainment упорно пытается оживить свои старые серии в рамках вселенной UGSF (Объединённые космические силы Галактики), куда уже входят Bosconian, Galaga и Xevious. notes.title: Shadow Labyrinth review
notes.content: Bandai Namco have built a massive love letter to the 2D Metroidvania, particularly the Metroid part. They’ve set it on a deadly planet where they want to tell a tragic sci-fi story of doomed soldiers, deadly superweapons, and, er, sibling rivalry. So you may think deciding it should star Pac-Man sounds like a terrible idea. Because it is. Because of course it is... Read more.

notes.title: Shadow Labyrinth (Nintendo Switch) Review
notes.content:
As strange as it is, I was really on board for Shadow Labyrinth. I try to maintain a why not policy when it comes to games, so when someone asks, “Why would Bandai Namco make an ultra-dark Metroid-like out of PAC-MAN?” My response is, “Why not?” It may not be something anyone asked for, but it’s fun that it exists anyway.

I supported Shadow Labyrinth in principle; however, the more I played it, the more that support waned. I really wanted to believe in this game, but for the few good ideas it has, it wastes them on a frustrating experience that doesn’t really understand what Metroid is, and doesn’t seem to know what it wants to be.

I can’t say much on the story for risk of spoilers, but if you’ve seen any of the pre-release trailers—or the Secret Level episode devoted to it—then you’ve got the gist of Shadow Labyrinth. A nameless hooded figure wakes up in a pod and is greeted by a sentient yellow orb calling itself PUCK. Able to wield a weapon called the ESP... Read more

notes.title: Shadow Labyrinth Hands-On Preview: Devouring Everything
notes.content:
Since Prime Video aired Secret Level, the PAC-MAN: Circle episode has lived rent-free in my head. Seeing a dystopian version of everyone’s favourite pellet-eating machine was a harrowing experience, especially when the episode embraced themes of existentialism, entrapment, and survival of the fittest. Secret Level managed this in just 12 minutes.

What I didn’t know was that this episode set the stage for the upcoming dark and twisted action-adventure Pac-Man-inspired title, Shadow Labyrinth. When I was offered a chance to check out Shadow Labyrinth and see a darker-than-the-arcade version of PAC-MAN, I leapt at the chance and walked away impressed. Shadow Labyrinth brings metroidvania-like action and sweaty platforming sequences to the forefront of the labyrinth, and for the Bandai-loyal, there are some surprises included that will drive nostalgia across the entire experience.

notes.title: Release Date and New Gameplay Revealed!
notes.content:
[h2]We are very excited to announce that Shadow Labyrinth is coming very soon, on July 18th, and that the pre-orders are finally open! [/h2]

[h3]To let you in on more of the game's secrets, we have prepared a brand-new trailer that shows 3 different ways to play Shadow Labyrinth. [/h3]

[previewyoutube=3ntSBn35JlM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]This new trailer spotlights the never-before-seen gameplay where you can take on the form of a massive robotic mech called [b]GAIA[/b]. While in this form you will inflict devastating damage on enemies and level the playing field for battles with some of the game’s most epically huge bosses. 

Now you know that there are [b]3 modes[/b] of play the game: 
[olist]
[*] controlling the [b]Swordsman No.8 [/b]is all about weapon use and artfully dodging, 
[*] [b]Mini PUCK mode[/b] is all about exploring hidden and out of reach pathways, 
[*] and [b]GAIA [/b]is Shadow Labyrinth's version of a Power Pellet: a robotic giant with devastating force!
[/olist][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343429/958d7eb3630e2fdfdd50cb851a5204f5e61b2344.jpg[/img]

[h3]Stay on the lookout for more secrets and surprises from Shadow Labyrinth and don't forget to preorder now and discover a new mysterious world[b] on July 18th[/b]![/h3]
